title: Business as casual: a reflection of Montreal’s business landscape | Archipel - Creative Communications Agency

facts.fact: The Archipel case study 'Business as casual' is dated 2024.
facts.quote: 2024 ## Business as casual: a reflection of Montreal’s business landscape

facts.fact: The client for the Business as casual project was Startup Montreal.
The Business as casual platform's tagline was 'Business as casual', chosen to highlight Montreal's friendly atmosphere and casual approach to business.
facts.quote: Highlighting Montreal’s friendly atmosphere as well as its casual approach to business, the platform’s tagline was _“Business as casual”_.

facts.fact: Archipel developed a bilingual communications platform for Montreal's and Quebec's startup ecosystem in collaboration with Startup Montréal, the Ministry of International Relations and the City of Montreal.
facts.quote: Archipel worked closely with Startup Montréal, the Ministry of International Relations and the City of Montreal to develop a bilingual communications platform.

facts.fact: The platform's deliverables included dynamic illustrations, an animated video and communications media for Startup Montréal's ambassadors.
facts.quote: It included dynamic illustrations, an animated video and communications media for Startup Montréal’s ambassadors.

facts.fact: The project's mandate was to boost the visibility of Montreal's and Quebec's startup ecosystem and position Montreal and Quebec as prime destinations for investments and partnerships in startup and innovation fields.
facts.quote: Montreal and Quebec had to be positioned as prime destinations in terms of investments and partnerships in the startup and innovation fields.
